cohort: 21 patients with histologically confirmed abdominal wall endometriosis (AWE) who underwent surgical treatment at a tertiary care center.
finding: Wide excision for abdominal wall endometriosis (AWE), with mesh repair for defects 3 cm or larger, is an effective treatment with low recurrence rates.
mod_finding: All patients with abdominal wall endometriosis had a prior cesarean section.
